import re
import sys

values = {}
pattern = re.compile(r"(\w+)\s*<-\s*(\w+|\d+)\s*;")

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0].strip()
    match = pattern.fullmatch(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
